summary.conclusion: Existing cache supports no same-frame E1 reference swap on the current 49 Top1 anchors. Eight old Native/R1 sources have zero exact source/query/video matches against the current 32. The old clean P1 DINO cache has two strict same-source matches, HC03 and HC16, including same locked PLAN row/ordinal and source video, exact current/old loaded source model-state SHA, source checkpoint SHA, pixel SHA, frame grid, interval and native predictions. But their current Top1 anchors are at different source-grid positions and physical frames from every DINO observation saved in the cache; the cache holds four sparse independent DINO observations and has no dense track or persistent ID. Any same-support E1 for these two would require new DINO inference at the exact QA frame; both were previously P1 confirmation queries, so are historically exposed.

limitations: Current reference geometry was read only as metadata to extract source-grid position and physical frame ID; no box coordinates were exported.

The historical P1 input cache does not store a separate query_key_sha256 or direct video SHA; identity is tied to the identical byte-locked original PLAN and exact ordinal, and cross-checked with current video SHA from that row, source frame IDs, pixel SHA, checkpoint and loaded model-state hashes.
No GT annotation, image, video, expert output prose or new prediction was used.
An earlier broad text search incidentally returned a large generated public-entry JSON with already-scored metrics in tool output; no metric values were inspected or used.
